overview: OpenAI and Anthropic slashed LLM prices dramatically, citing lower cache costs and competitive pressure; pricing cuts affect developer budgets and market dynamics.
Researchers explore optimal distillation strategies for LLM agents, questioning on‑policy vs off‑policy training levels.
A new framework proposes tool‑driven agentic synthesis for RF and mmWave hardware design, highlighting automation potential.

top.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
top.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic reduced LLM prices up to 80% by cutting cache read costs and introducing cheaper model tiers, lowering operational expenses for developers and intensifying price competition.

top.title: Beyond On-Policy vs. Off-Policy: At What Level Should LLM Agent Distillation Follow the Student?
top.summary: A paper investigates whether LLM agent distillation should follow on‑policy or off‑policy methods, aiming to improve student model efficiency and alignment.

top.title: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
top.summary: Researchers present TACS‑RF, a tool‑driven agentic system that automates synthesis of RF and mmWave modules, demonstrating AI’s role in hardware design.

top.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
top.summary: Google’s AI Overviews place AI‑generated summaries atop search results, diverting clicks from original publishers and threatening their traffic and revenue.

top.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
top.summary: UC Berkeley Fields Medalist stops grading homework after students consistently use AI to achieve top scores, questioning the relevance of traditional assessment.

top.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
top.summary: Paris Marx’s book traces worldwide opposition to data‑center growth, linking environmental impacts to political movements and warning of AI‑driven demand.
